sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is semantically verified: the only coverage term is a ship-level boolean aggregate explicitly rejected by the feedback, while the remaining candidates do not represent a per-installation/per-equipment, per-hazard coverage relationship or coverage fact paired with evidence.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the hazard-coverage logic: a ship-level boolean with sh:hasValue true is only presence/aggregate evidence and does not establish protection for each machinery installation and its associated equipment against every applicable hazard. Encode the per-installation/per-associated-equipment coverage relationship or controlled coverage facts, preserve the six controlled hazard alternatives, and require the complete applicable set rather than allowing sh:minCount 1 with sh:in to pass when only one hazard is recorded.
